notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Battered Golem.
Battered Golem does not have summoning sickness and has a power of 1 or greater.
description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste and a Food artifact token.
When the Food enters the battlefield, Battered Golem triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
